subject: SSO login failure - details attached
body: We're seeing single sign-on failures affecting some users, starting we noticed it over the past week or so. The one change on our side around that time: an admin cleaned up some group-to-role mappings in our directory. What we've already checked: spot-checked a couple of affected accounts in our directory, looked normal there. Please let us know what artifact or evidence you need from us to pin this down.
